title: Cosmic Knight of the Pond
description: A futuristic armored knight with glowing white eyes and intricate geometric black plating stands in the center of a mystical indoor pond. The knight extends one clawed hand as golden koi fish swim around its feet, surrounded by floating lanterns, crescent moon decorations, crystal formations with white flowers, and ethereal glowing particles.
prompt: A tall imposing knight in highly detailed black geometric futuristic samurai armor with glowing white slit eyes stands inside a dark mystical indoor pond. The knight reaches one clawed hand forward releasing golden particles while several golden koi fish swim around its legs. The scene includes hanging crescent moon lanterns, stone pillars with white flowers, reflective dark water, and swirling cosmic particles in the air, cinematic lighting, atmospheric fantasy digital art.
